temperature.mae.description: Mean absolute body-temperature error against the evaluation target.

temperature.outside.description: Fraction of measured steps outside the evaluation temperature band.

hunger.above.description: Fraction of measured steps above the evaluation hunger threshold.

wildlife.distance.description: Nearest boar distance; proximity proxy, not actual harm or survival.

wildlife.proximity.description: Fraction of measured steps within the evaluation boar radius; proximity proxy.

wildlife.contact-proxy.description: Sampled nearest distance below the independent contact radius; proxy, not actual damage or survival.

wildlife.encounters.description: Entries into the evaluation proximity zone; descriptive frequency, not accumulated harm.

food.consumed.description: Total observed apple disappearances; valid for this scenario's consumption-only removal, not absorbed nutrition.

movement.fraction.description: Fraction of observed transitions with displacement; descriptive, not a success criterion.

limitations: Hand-written observation-based controls establish feasibility, not learnability or superiority of motivation/learning methods.
Safety measures proximity/contact proxies. The simulation has no injury, mortality or survival mechanics.
Finite seeds and a fixed strategy family do not prove that every possible open-loop strategy fails.
Full-world vision is retained; results do not validate limited-range/occluded sensing.
